data.summary: The diff is a frontend theming and styling refactor. It adds no new dependencies, secrets, network calls or injection sinks. A grep of ui/src found no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, innerHTML, eval or plain http:// use. The theme code reads and writes only the value 'theme' in localStorage, and it validates that value against a light/dark allow-list. The inline script in Layout.astro is static and uses no user data. The privacy-mode fix now masks the Profit percentage and hides the gain/loss badge, which closes the earlier information leak. The diff output was truncated, so I could not read the middle of it, which includes the modal and ui component files. The grep covered all of ui/src and found nothing in them.
